cd /app/work && timeout 170 python3 -c "
import random, sys, json, copy
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work'); sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submission')
import gen2, planner, numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import linprog
rng = random.Random(31)
cnt = {'feas':0,'infeas':0,'parse':0}
for i in range(60):
    r = gen2.gen(rng)
    r['budget']=98304; r['failed_edges']=[]
    try:
        prob = planner.parse_request((json.dumps(r)+'\n').encode())
    except Exception as e:
        cnt['parse']+=1; continue
    model = planner.Model(prob)
    res = linprog(model.c, A_ub=model.A, b_ub=model.b, A_eq=model.E, b_eq=model.d, bounds=(0,None), method='highs')
    if res.status==0: cnt['feas']+=1
    elif res.status==2: cnt['infeas']+=1
    else: print('odd', res.status)
print(cnt)
"
